extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in comedy/pop-culture and Ranker voters
extracted.subtask_description: A Ranker listicle that ranks comedians perceived as 'cancelled' or widely disliked, explaining reasons (theft, misconduct, persona, style) and inviting readers to vote. Used to judge why certain comics are hated and to order them by public votes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Witty, charming, and funny (qualities of good stand-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: The best stand-up comedians don't have an easy job. You have to be witty, charming and most importantly funny.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit standard against which comedians are measured: those who lack wit, charm, or genuine funniness are more likely to be disliked or 'cancelled.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Stealing material / joke thief
rubrics_metrics.description: Ever since Joe Rogan exposed Carlos as a joke thief, he's become public enemy #1 in the comedy universe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being caught stealing material (joke theft) is presented as a cardinal sin that causes long-lasting reputational harm and is a primary reason for hatred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unoriginal / 'hack' / hacky material
rubrics_metrics.description: No one respects an unoriginal hack. Dat Phan is described as 'one of the hackiest comics on the planet.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeatedly relying on tired, derivative, or low-effort jokes (being a 'hack' or 'cornball') is a reason for being disliked; includes criticism like 'hackiest', 'cornballs', and 'one-trick' formulaic acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlikable / annoying persona or delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: People can't help but find Kathy Griffin annoying. It could be her voice, it could be her style of delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annoying vocal qualities, delivery style, or general unlikability (tone/voice) are cited as reasons audiences turn against a comedian.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phony persona / inauthentic identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Larry the Cable Guy's whole southern persona is completely phony — he's not really a redneck.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perceived inauthenticity (adopting a fake persona for laughs or branding) damages credibility and leads to dislike or accusations of being a 'phony.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Sexual misconduct and abuse allegations
rubrics_metrics.description: Cosby has been the subject of highly publicized accusations of rape, drug-facilitated sexual assault, sexual battery, child sexual abuse, and sexual misconduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serious allegations of sexual assault, drug-facilitated assault, sexual battery, child sexual abuse, and related misconduct are explicit, concrete grounds for being 'cancelled' and strongly drive public hatred; public revelations often prompt more accusers to come forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domestic allegations / other personal misconduct
rubrics_metrics.description: In recent years, a number of cancelled comedians have been outed for deplorable behavior, such as ... domestic allegations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-sexual but harmful personal behaviors (domestic incidents, abusive conduct) contribute to a comedian being ostracized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political or extremist opinion propagandizing
rubrics_metrics.description: Far-right opinion propagandizing are often modern culprits for comedians getting cancelled right now.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using a comedy platform to spread extreme or polarizing political views (e.g., far-right propaganda) can lead to cancellation and public backlash.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accusations of lifting material (plagiarism/borrowing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dane Cook was accused of lifting some of Louis CK's material, a subject Louis turned into an episode of his hit show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if not criminal, accusations of lifting jokes or material (plagiarism/borrowing) damage reputation and are a cause for derision among peers and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bullying fellow comics behind the scenes
rubrics_metrics.description: Schaub has faced accusations of bullying fellow comics behind the scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Professional bullying or mistreatment of colleagues is cited as a reason comedians are disliked, reflecting community norms about conduct offstage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inappropriate comments and unwanted sexual advances
rubrics_metrics.description: Schaub has also inappropriately commented on other comics wives/significant others, while also approaching them with unwanted sexual advances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Making lewd/inappropriate remarks about others' partners or engaging in unwanted sexual approaches are specific behaviors that contribute to cancellation.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-trick pony / over-reliance on identity-based jokes
rubrics_metrics.description: All Phan talks about being Vietnamese, making him the definition of a one-trick pony.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relying on a single angle (ethnicity, catchphrase, or recurring personal anecdote) signals limited range and invites criticism for being stale or shallow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voting rule: vote if they deserve universal hatred
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting Rules: Vote up the comics if you feel they deserve to be universally hated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural instruction to readers on how to participate: upvote comedians the reader believes deserve to be 'universally hated' — sets the rhetorical/affective criterion for inclusion and ranking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ranking via community metrics (votes and upvote rate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry shows number of votes and an upvote rate (e.g., '682 voters with a 74% upvote rate').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list's ordering and perceived consensus are derived from crowd voting metrics (vote counts and percent upvote), which function as the operational measure of how disliked a comedian is on this page.
